I implemented `minidb/parser.py` (`parse`, `parse_script` and `parse_expression`), and all 33 tests in `tests/test_parser.py` pass. I didn't run the other test files, so the integration tests aren't checked.

I didn't need to edit `tests/test_parser.py`. It builds its tokens by hand, so it doesn't depend on the unimplemented tokenizer.

The parser is a small private `_Parser` class with one method per grammar rule, following the grammar in `minidb.types`. If the token list doesn't end with an EOF token, the parser adds one rather than raising an error. That case isn't covered by a test.
